name: Numen (1.16.5 port)
description: CLIENT build of Numen for Minecraft 1.16.5 - install this on your client to meet companions: G opens a companion's inventory like a chest (put things in, take them out), B opens the settings panel, and anything typed in the vanilla chat reaches the companion's agent on the server, whose thinking and doings narrate back into the chat. The server must run the Numen server mod. Unofficial port of https://github.com/Dwinovo/minecraft-numen
